quality.review_scope: An earlier independent quick audit accepted the scoped main-text route and cited structure outcomes; only explicit time/sample/figure links are assigned. A later independent targeted U1/U2 review accepted the Figure 3 input-colloid sizes and optional assembly choices. SI Figure S1 was checked only to exclude an unproven Figure 3 aliquot join; the SI as a whole and ref. 17 remain unreviewed.
missing_fields: PbTe precursor synthesis is only cited to a separate 2006 paper; it was not source-checked in this package.
Exact colloid concentration, per-specimen volumes, evaporation time and pressure are unreported.
Precursor Ag2Te maturation aliquot for Figure 3 sample is not identified; do not join to a specific Figure 2 sample.
Superlattice type is a projection/model assignment, not atomistic interface coordinates.
The Figure 3a solvent choice among trichloroethylene, toluene and their mixture is unreported; mixture ratio is unreported.

The Figure 3a modifier choice among optional oleic acid and TOPO solutions is unreported; TOPO dose and formulation are unreported. The approximately 4 µL OA/TCE example is not assigned to this specimen.
conflicts: Main p.3 / printed 117 says reproducible ordered samples were achieved only with a charged amphiphilic ligand; Methods p.7 / printed 121 describes OA or TOPO additions as optimal. Neither passage assigns a ligand option to Figure 3a or 3b.
